focus_areas: Geometric separation of wig from forehead (Depth Audit)
Boundary integrity using BBox priors (Topology Audit)
Micro-texture fidelity of hair strands (Perceptual Audit)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the wig's hairline and the subject's forehead. Use the geometric depth map to confirm the wig is physically sitting on top of the skull and not merging with the melting makeup. Evaluate if the hair texture is uniformly 'plastic' (AI artifact) or if it shows realistic micro-variations, relying on the perceptual auditor rather than just visual inspection.
image_description: A close-up portrait of a person wearing a voluminous, curly black wig. The subject's face features heavy, surreal prosthetic makeup that appears to be melting or peeling, particularly around the eyes and forehead. The wig dominates the upper frame with dense, dark curls against a black background.
